title: personal.json sidebar_channels
description: The personal order of the posts of a forum (table user_channel_states, docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2), archived channels included. Only channel and thread IDs, never a name or a title.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the row belongs to.

thread_order.description: The personal order of the posts of the channel, as thread IDs; empty for the default order.

updated_by_device_id.description: ID of the device of the last change; absent when unknown or the device is gone.

updated_at.description: When the row was last changed.
